name: work_performance
title: Bayesian hierarchical model of self-control and work performance
description: Bayesian hierarchical normal model reproducing the fully adjusted Model 2 from Baumann, Danilov, and Stavrova (2023). Includes correlated participant-specific random intercepts and time slopes, a self-control-by-time interaction, and demographic, work-related, and Big Five covariates. Uses a non-centred parameterisation.
